⭐ Recommended legacy version: Most stable and reliable 2.7.x Magister release.
Download .xapk files directly to your Downloads folder and install them with XAPK Installer.
We recommend downloading the official XAPK Installer app from the Google Play Store to easily install standalone .xapk files.
1. Tap \'Download to Downloads folder\' below for your chosen XAPK version.
2. Open the XAPK Installer app on your phone (download via button above).
3. Locate the downloaded .xapk file in your Downloads folder and tap \'Install\'.
